activities.details: Code embeds the query, fetches pgvector and full-text candidates, keeps the ones that fit the budget and have places left, and reranks them with Cohere. The calling step decides when to search; no model runs inside.
activities.title: Hybrid retrieval started

activities.sql_query:
SELECT * FROM semantic_trip_search($1::vector, $2::integer)
-- Values: $1 = '[0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25... (5121 characters)', $2 = 25

WITH raw AS ( SELECT websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)::text AS text_query ), parts AS ( SELECT (SELECT string_agg(part, ' | ') FROM unnest(string_to_array(text_query, ' & ')) AS part WHERE left(part, 1) <> '!') AS positives, (SELECT string_agg(part, ' & ') FROM unnest(string_to_array(text_query, ' & ')) AS part WHERE left(part, 1) = '!') AS negatives FROM raw ), q AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN positives IS NULL THEN negatives WHEN negatives IS NULL THEN '(' || positives || ')' ELSE '(' || positives || ') & ' || negatives END::tsquery AS tsq FROM parts ) SELECT package_id, name, operator, price_per_person, description, image_url, trip_type, destination, region, durations, package_places_left(package_id) AS availability, highlights, ts_rank(search_vector, q.tsq) AS lexical_score FROM trip_packages, q WHERE search_vector @@ q.tsq ORDER BY lexical_score DESC LIMIT $2
-- Values: $1 = 'Tokyo city trips under $1900', $2 = 25
activities.title: Hybrid candidates fetched
